source_snapshot.test_name_items: All HDD NVMe LED Check - Present
source_snapshot.procedure:
【Before Test】
    1. Check that the SUT configuration (e.g., hardware, firmware, drivers, etc.) matches the specifications/recipe definition.
    2. Clear logs (e.g., dmesg, syslog, SEL, etc.).

    【During Test】
    Check if present LED function works normally

1. Insert NVMe SSD into BP slot and check present LED

    【After Test】
    1. Collect test results and photos, and save them to specific folders.
    2. Check if there are unexpected logs (e.g., dmesg, syslog, SEL, etc.) generate after test.
source_snapshot.criteria: 1. Check system spec define LED function

deepseek_columns.ai_commands: Undocumented raw IPMI bytes plus `lsblk` inventory.
deepseek_columns.ai_logs_output: Command output, device list and operator observation.

historical_reviews.deepseek: PARTIAL; includes operator observation but proposes an unvalidated OEM raw command that may affect unrelated BMC state.
historical_reviews.gpt_v2: REQUIRES PACKAGE / USER CONFIRMATION / CHANGED; requires supported LED mapping, stable slot identity, safe insertion and physical proof.

original_test_intent: Across the project-defined NVMe bay population, verify that inserting the approved SSD causes the specification-defined Present/power indicator on the corresponding physical slot.
original_method: A qualified operator inserts the serial-identified SSD into each mapped backplane slot using the approved power-state procedure and records the physical Present LED; the agent captures matching enumeration and BMC/controller events without issuing unrelated LED control.
manual_activity: Every tested bay requires physical SSD insertion and visual confirmation of its indicator. Those actions are the core acceptance, so MANUAL ONLY applies regardless of automated inventory support.
required_inputs: Declared `all HDD` NVMe bay population and stable bay/enclosure/controller map
Present/power LED color/state/timing per platform specification
SSD model/serial/firmware and per-bay hot-plug or powered-off procedure
Operator, ESD, camera and evidence naming method
safety_requirements: Do not insert while powered unless the specific bay is documented hot-plug capable.
Exclude boot, active data, protected and unknown devices and verify serial-to-bay identity.
Do not send raw IPMI bytes without OEM documentation and exact target semantics.
Do not initialize, format or mount the SSD as part of the LED check.
Stop on power, thermal, media, management or mapping fault; no automatic reseat or alternate-bay retry.
agent_execution_scope: Validate population/mapping and collect baseline OS/controller/BMC state.
Timestamp enumeration and events around each operator insertion.
Correlate every photo/observation with the same SSD and bay.
Summarize per-bay Tool Results without claiming physical observation or verdict.
engineer_actions: Approve and physically insert the SSD in each in-scope bay.
Visually record Present LED behavior against the truth table.
Review per-bay discrepancies and assign PASS/FAIL.

command_applicability.original_deepseek_command_fit: `lsblk` is useful corroboration, but the raw `0x3a 0x0e...` command is undocumented, untargeted and unnecessary for a hardware-driven Present LED; it must not be run generically.
command_applicability.command_recommendation: Use read-only inventory/event APIs documented for the exact platform; keep physical insertion and visual evidence as authoritative.
command_applicability.original_parameters_and_time_preserved: All-HDD NVMe scope, insertion, Present LED check and 15/8-minute fields are preserved.

modernized_recommendation.recommended_method: Record each bay/SSD combination with synchronized photo and serial-correlated enumeration, using no management write unless an OEM document explicitly requires it.
modernized_recommendation.applicable_platform: Exact chassis/backplane, NVMe drives and firmware.
modernized_recommendation.supported_version: Record backplane/CPLD/BMC/controller firmware and inventory utility versions.
modernized_recommendation.official_reference: Platform LED truth table, bay map and NVMe service guide.
modernized_recommendation.difference_from_original_method: Adds complete population traceability and removes reliance on unverified raw control.
modernized_recommendation.risks_limitations: Management/device presence cannot prove physical LED color or operation.

project_override_considerations: The project defines the bay population represented by `all`. Reports must list it explicitly and may not generalize beyond tested bays or drive types.
expected_evidence: Approved SSD/bay population, hot-plug policy and LED truth table
Per-bay operator insertion timestamp and Present LED photo/video
Matching controller/OS enumeration plus BMC/SEL event window
Final health, per-bay Tool Result and separate engineer verdict

source_conflict_analysis.analysis: Procedure and criterion consistently defer Present LED behavior to the platform specification. The raw DeepSeek addition is not source authority and is rejected rather than creating a source conflict.

blocked_analysis.analysis: The test intent is clear and becomes ready with the population, LED specification and safe operator procedure.

comparison_to_prior_reviews.deepseek: Preserves inventory/physical split but rejects the undocumented raw BMC command.
comparison_to_prior_reviews.gpt_v2: Retains identity and safety controls; applies MANUAL ONLY because every accepted result is a physical observation.
comparison_to_prior_reviews.v3_1_improvement: Makes all-bay coverage measurable and command provenance mandatory.

review_improvement: Avoids changing unknown BMC state and prevents one observed bay from being reported as all-HDD coverage.
independent_technical_reasoning: Present indication is caused by physical insertion and verified visually. No portable BMC command can replace that platform-specific human evidence, so MANUAL ONLY is the only faithful classification.
no_automatic_retry: Do not repeat insertion, issue alternate raw bytes or move to another bay after failure without engineer disposition.
